hist_case.problem: Build V1 Voice Presence: turn-completion confidence + graceful TTS interruption decay
hist_case.case_text: First of five Communication System versions (founder-locked build order 2026-08-06). Prototype already proven 39/39 in scripts/prototype-conversational-contracts-v1.mjs; this mission ports it into a live, callable service and wires it into the real voice pipeline.
hist_case.opportunity: Closes the real abandonment-failure gap (Chair talking over the founder mid-interruption) using already-proven scoring logic -- no new algorithm risk.
